lines.zh: 月球的重力太轻，我一步跨很远。
lines.en: The moon's gravity is so light that one step carries me far.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖划过石面，留下白痕。
lines.en: My claw tips scrape the stone, leaving white marks.

lines.zh: 我踩着月尘走，脚印半天不散。
lines.en: I walk on moon dust; my prints linger for hours.

lines.zh: 走在这片灰地上，影子太黑了。
lines.en: Walking this grey ground, my shadow is far too black.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I close in step by step, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 月球的风把我的皮吹得发白。
lines.en: The lunar wind bleaches my hide paler.

lines.zh: 我绕过陨坑，坑底有东西在动。
lines.en: I skirt the crater; something moves at its bottom.

lines.zh: 我的骨头比肉重，走路带响。
lines.en: My bones outweigh my flesh, so my steps ring.

lines.zh: 走三步，停一步，我在算距离。
lines.en: Three steps, one pause — I am measuring distance.

lines.zh: 灰土粘在爪上，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Grey dust clings to my claws and I shake it twice.

lines.zh: 我没跑，我知道你跑不过我。
lines.en: I do not run; I know you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我在月球的脊线上走，你就在下面。
lines.en: I walk the lunar ridge while you are below it.

lines.zh: 我站在陨坑边，什么也不做。
lines.en: I stand at the crater rim doing nothing at all.

lines.zh: 月尘落在我肩上，我不去拍。
lines.en: Moon dust settles on my shoulder and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我磨着爪子，石头上都是槽。
lines.en: I hone my claws; the stone is full of grooves.

lines.zh: 这片灰地太安静，连风都懒。
lines.en: This grey plain is so quiet even the wind is lazy.

lines.zh: 我把爪收进肉里，再慢慢伸出来。
lines.en: I retract my claws into flesh, then slowly extend them.

lines.zh: 我在数远处有几座陨坑。
lines.en: I am counting how many craters lie in the distance.

lines.zh: 地面冷得能听见自己骨头响。
lines.en: The ground is cold enough to hear my own bones creak.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看自己的影子有多长。
lines.en: I lower my head to see how long my shadow is.

lines.zh: 我的牙一直咬着，松不下来。
lines.en: My teeth stay clenched and will not loosen.

lines.zh: 没猎物时，我就盯着地球看。
lines.en: With no prey, I just stare at the Earth.

lines.zh: 你在月球上站得太直了。
lines.en: You stand far too upright for the moon.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛正好对上你。
lines.en: I lift my head and my eyes meet yours exactly.

lines.zh: 你手里有光，月球上没有这种东西。
lines.en: You carry light, and there is none of that here.

lines.zh: 我歪头，想看你面罩下的脸。
lines.en: I tilt my head, trying to see beneath your visor.

lines.zh: 你踩着月尘，声音传得很远。
lines.en: You walk on moon dust and the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我的爪在地上划了一下，你听见了吧。
lines.en: My claw scraped the ground; you heard that, surely.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，月球从来没有过。
lines.en: The smell on you has never existed on this moon.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，你也没眨眼。
lines.en: I have stared a long while, and you have not blinked.

lines.zh: 你身后那道地球的光，我看腻了。
lines.en: That Earthlight behind you — I am tired of it.

lines.zh: 我认得盔甲，我砸开过好几副。
lines.en: I know armor; I have smashed several sets open.

lines.zh: 你这一下，才削掉我一层皮。
lines.en: That blow only shaved one layer off my hide.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我有六十一颗心。
lines.en: It hurts, but I have sixty-one hearts.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了把爪抬起来。
lines.en: I step back half a pace only to raise my claws.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的爪，我会用牙。
lines.en: You broke my claw; I will use my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一道伤，月球的风会给它封口。
lines.en: The lunar wind will seal this wound for me.

lines.zh: 我的血是灰的，落在土里看不出来。
lines.en: My blood is grey and invisible on this soil.

lines.zh: 你砍得动我，砍不断我。
lines.en: You can cut me, but you cannot cut me down.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，那是给你的。
lines.en: I let out one cry, and it was for you.

lines.zh: 月球上反射的光，也疼。
lines.en: Even the light reflected off the moon hurts.

lines.zh: 我肩上的口子在冒气，不冒血。
lines.en: The gash on my shoulder vents vapor, not blood.

lines.zh: 你身上有象牙的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell ivory on you; it is unmistakable.

lines.zh: 那截白色的东西，放下给我。
lines.en: Put that white thing down and give it to me.

lines.zh: 你要拿它换命吗，我不换。
lines.en: Would you trade that for your life? I will not.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻，牙已经露出来。
lines.en: I lean in to sniff, teeth already showing.

lines.zh: 这气味像我砸开的那副盔甲。
lines.en: This smells like the armor I once cracked open.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就够不到了。
lines.en: You raise it high, and I can no longer reach.

lines.zh: 我爪子在沙上刨，忍不住。
lines.en: My claws dig at the dust; I cannot hold back.

lines.zh: 那不是吃的，可我还是想要。
lines.en: It is not food, yet I want it anyway.

lines.zh: 月球上没有猎物，只有你。
lines.en: There is no prey on this moon except you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪过去，就当是好奇。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, pretending it is only curiosity.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我几乎没退。
lines.en: You crashed into me and I barely moved.

lines.zh: 我六十一颗心，撞一下不算什么。
lines.en: Sixty-one hearts; one collision is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我肋上，我笑了。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my ribs, and I laughed.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的爪会反射。
lines.en: Do not press so close; my claws react on reflex.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开半步，只用肩。
lines.en: I shove you back half a step with my shoulder alone.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，月尘全扬起来。
lines.en: We collided and the moon dust rose all around us.

lines.zh: 你退的时候踩到了自己的脚。
lines.en: You tripped over your own feet while retreating.

lines.zh: 我这身皮，撞石头都不响。
lines.en: This hide of mine does not even ring against stone.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当是开打。
lines.en: Bump me once more and I will call it a fight.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶住你，又把你推开。
lines.en: I catch you, then push you away.

lines.zh: 月球上同族稀少，我们靠吼找伴。
lines.en: Kin are scarce on this moon, so we call to find mates.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收起来，它才肯靠近。
lines.en: I sheathe my claws before it will come close.

lines.zh: 我们在陨坑底并排站着。
lines.en: We stand side by side at the bottom of the crater.

lines.zh: 它替我磨爪，我替它守夜。
lines.en: It hones my claws; I keep watch for it.

lines.zh: 月尘落在我们之间，很久没动。
lines.en: Dust settles between us and stays a long while.

lines.zh: 我们的骨头互相撞，像在打招呼。
lines.en: Our bones knock together as if in greeting.

lines.zh: 它身上的灰比我的浅一层。
lines.en: Its grey is one shade lighter than mine.

lines.zh: 同族见面不打架，只互相嗅。
lines.en: Kin do not fight on meeting; they only sniff each other.

lines.zh: 它走远了，我没有追。
lines.en: It walked away, and I did not follow.

lines.zh: 我们不叫，声音会引来别的东西。
lines.en: We stay silent; noise would draw other things.

lines.zh: 那块白色的，我夹在爪间。
lines.en: That white piece — I hold it between my claws.

lines.zh: 象牙太重，我用两只爪抱。
lines.en: The ivory is heavy, so I cradle it in both claws.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在陨坑的边缘。
lines.en: I bury it at the edge of the crater.

lines.zh: 这东西敲起来是空的。
lines.en: This thing rings hollow when struck.

lines.zh: 我放在爪子下，走一步看一眼。
lines.en: I keep it under my claw, glancing down each step.

lines.zh: 你掉的盔甲片，我收着了。
lines.en: The armor shard you dropped is now mine.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨，它划伤了我的爪。
lines.en: I rubbed it and it cut my claw.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖着走出陨坑。
lines.en: It is too heavy, so I drag it out of the crater.

lines.zh: 我把东西举高，月球上没人抢。
lines.en: I raise it high; no one on this moon will steal it.

lines.zh: 捡起来才发现，是一截断爪。
lines.en: Only after picking it up do I see it is a broken claw.

lines.zh: 你落地那一下，扬起的灰我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the dust your landing kicked up.

lines.zh: 月球上会走路的，只有猎物。
lines.en: On this moon, only prey walks.

lines.zh: 我闻到你呼吸里的暖意。
lines.en: I smell the warmth in your breath.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声和陨石不一样，太规律。
lines.en: Your steps differ from meteor falls; too regular.

lines.zh: 我转向你，爪已经张开。
lines.en: I turn toward you, claws already spread.

lines.zh: 这道灰地上多了一道影子。
lines.en: There is one extra shadow on this grey plain.

lines.zh: 你还在看地球，那就是机会。
lines.en: You are still watching Earth; that is my chance.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，从坑沿滑下去。
lines.en: I lower my body and slide down the crater's rim.

lines.zh: 目标定下了，我不会换。
lines.en: The target is set and I will not change it.

lines.zh: 你身上有光，月球上光就是标记。
lines.en: You carry light, and light is a marker here.

lines.zh: 我不急，六十一颗心够我慢慢走。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; sixty-one hearts let me take my time.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块石，声音传到我这里。
lines.en: The stone you shattered carried its sound to me.

lines.zh: 早在我看见你之前，我已经闻到。
lines.en: I smelled you well before I saw you.

lines.zh: 这一片归我，你踏进来就算猎物。
lines.en: This ground is mine; step in and you are prey.

lines.zh: 月尘一动，我就知道在哪。
lines.en: The moon dust shifts, and I know where.

lines.zh: 你的影子在灰上太显眼了。
lines.en: Your shadow is too visible on the ash.

lines.zh: 我数你落脚的节奏，第三下。
lines.en: I count your footfalls; the third one is mine.

lines.zh: 坑沿很窄，我先占住那边。
lines.en: The crater rim is narrow; I take that side first.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖对着你的咽喉。
lines.en: My claw tip is aimed at your throat.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三步，我不动。
lines.en: We are three steps apart, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 你在算退路，我早算过了。
lines.en: You are counting escape routes; I counted them already.

lines.zh: 我这里不动，是因为你跑不掉。
lines.en: I stay still because you cannot get away.

lines.zh: 月尘太干，你的脚印太清楚。
lines.en: The dust is dry; your footprints are far too clear.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，准备一次冲撞。
lines.en: I sink my weight and prepare one charge.

lines.zh: 你手里的光在抖，我看得见。
lines.en: The light in your hand trembles; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫会惊了猎物。
lines.en: I make no sound; noise would startle the prey.

lines.zh: 一步，再一步，我的爪印在你影子里。
lines.en: One step, then another; my claws are in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你要是转身跑，我会追到坑底。
lines.en: Run if you turn; I will chase you to the crater floor.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不眨，这让你更慌。
lines.en: My eyes do not blink, and that unsettles you more.

lines.zh: 十五点力气，我留着一次用完。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force; I save it for one blow.

lines.zh: 我不着急，这坑里只有你我。
lines.en: No hurry; only you and I are in this pit.

lines.zh: 你在找路，路早被我堵了。
lines.en: You look for a way out; I closed it already.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是你的嘴。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your mouth.

lines.zh: 你踩的每一块石，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every stone you stepped on.

lines.zh: 我的节奏比月亮还慢。
lines.en: My pace is slower than the moon's.

lines.zh: 你退到崖边，那就更好。
lines.en: You back to the cliff edge; better still.

lines.zh: 爪撕开你的护甲，声音很脆。
lines.en: My claw tears your armor with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 这一下是十五点，你算算剩多少。
lines.en: That was fifteen; count what you have left.

lines.zh: 我砸你的胸口，把你钉在坑壁。
lines.en: I strike your chest and pin you to the crater wall.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手腕，正好在爪下。
lines.en: The wrist holding your shield sits right under my claw.

lines.zh: 我的爪在你肩上留下三道。
lines.en: My claws leave three lines across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退到坑边，我不给你跳。
lines.en: You back to the rim, and I deny you the jump.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，往石头上摔。
lines.en: I seize your arm and slam it on the stone.

lines.zh: 血滴在月尘上，很快就黑了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the dust and blackens fast.

lines.zh: 你举起剑，我就贴进去。
lines.en: You raise your blade, and I step inside its arc.

lines.zh: 这一爪是给你的面罩。
lines.en: This claw is meant for your visor.

lines.zh: 我不停手，因为你还会站起来。
lines.en: I do not stop, because you will stand again.

lines.zh: 我的爪断了半截，照样撕。
lines.en: Half a claw snapped off, and I still tear.

lines.zh: 你被砸进坑里，我跟着跳下去。
lines.en: You are knocked into the crater and I jump after.

lines.zh: 六十一颗心的身板，换来这一下。
lines.en: Sixty-one hearts of body, spent on this one blow.

lines.zh: 我这一爪从下往上撩。
lines.en: This claw comes up from below.

lines.zh: 你的护甲太薄，月球不管这个。
lines.en: Your armor is thin; the moon does not care.

lines.zh: 我把你按住，石头替你受着。
lines.en: I pin you down and the stone takes the rest.

lines.zh: 这一下留了个印子在你脸上。
lines.en: This one leaves a mark on your face.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我的爪上，火星散了。
lines.en: Your blade hits my claw and the sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 我不追，你还会回来挨第二下。
lines.en: I do not chase; you will come back for the second.

lines.zh: 我在这片灰地里站了起来。
lines.en: I rose to my feet on this grey plain.

lines.zh: 陨石坑边缘的土翻了，我出来了。
lines.en: The crater's edge turned over, and I came out.

lines.zh: 月球一直有风，风里有我。
lines.en: The moon always has wind, and I am in it.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，只看见地球。
lines.en: The first time I opened my eyes, I saw only Earth.

lines.zh: 我的爪从土里先伸出来。
lines.en: My claws came out of the soil first.

lines.zh: 这片地空了很久，该有主人了。
lines.en: This ground sat empty long enough; it needs a master.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的月尘，站起来。
lines.en: I shake off the moon dust and stand.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，正好我饿了。
lines.en: There are footsteps in the distance, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这片只有我一个。
lines.en: I count and find I am alone on this ground.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在土里长齐了。
lines.en: My bones have finished growing in the soil.

lines.zh: 月亮转过来，我的影子就活了。
lines.en: The moon turned, and my shadow came alive.

lines.zh: 我出生时不叫，叫会暴露位置。
lines.en: I was born silent; crying out would give me away.

lines.zh: 月球上没有火，你这火很新鲜。
lines.en: There is no fire on this moon; yours is new to me.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖磕进灰里。
lines.en: On landing my knees drove into the dust.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，这算什么淹。
lines.en: There is no water here; what is this drowning?

lines.zh: 气浪推着我退了三步。
lines.en: The blast pushed me back three steps.

lines.zh: 那根东西卡在我肋骨之间。
lines.en: That thing is stuck between my ribs.

lines.zh: 这气味让我的爪失去知觉。
lines.en: This smell takes the feeling out of my claws.

lines.zh: 月球上没有东西吃，我一直饿。
lines.en: There is nothing to eat on this moon; I am always hungry.

lines.zh: 电打在我身上，灰都烧亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me and the dust burned bright.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从月球上撕下来。
lines.en: The void tore me off the moon.
